newsitem.title: USA: New York Times Q4 earnings summary.
newsitem.headline: New York Times Q4 earnings summary.

text.p: 12 MONTHS
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)
Note: First call Q4 mean estimate $0.61 a share.
Net income for 1996 was reduced by a non-cash accounting charge of $94.5 million or $0.97 per share, taken in the third quarter of 1996.

$31.5 million pre-tax charge for the fourth quarter ($.18 per share) and $44.1 million pre-tax charge for the year ($.25 per share) for severance and related costs resulting from work force reductions ("buyouts").

$126.8 million pre-tax charge for the year ($.97 per share) resulting from a non-cash charge relating to the Financial Accounting Standards Board No. 121, Accounting for Impairment of Long-Lived Assets and for Long-Lived Assets To Be Disposed Of ("SFAS 121 charge").
$25.1 million pre-tax gain for the year ($.14 per share) resulting from the realization of a gain contingency from the disposition of a paper mill in a prior year.
$7.8 million pre-tax gain for the year ($.04 per share) from the sale of the 110 Fifth Avenue building.
$10.1 million pre-tax charge for the fourth quarter and the year ($.06 per share) for buyouts.
$11.3 million pre-tax gain for the year ($.05 per share) resulting from a sale of six small regional newspapers.

1996 earnings excluding the SFAS 121 charge and gains on dispositions and before interest, income taxes, depreciation and amortization ("EBITDA") rose to $138.4 million in the 1996 fourth quarter from $93.2 million in the comparable 1995 period. EBITDA for 1996 rose to $466.1 million from $383.7 million in 1995.
